#!/bin/bash
# steamcmd Base Installation Script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
# Image to install with is 'ghcr.io/ptero-eggs/installers:debian'

##
#
# Variables
# STEAM_USER, STEAM_PASS, STEAM_AUTH - Steam user setup. If a user has 2fa enabled it will most likely fail due to timeout. Leave blank for anon install.
# SRCDS_APPID - Steam app id of the dedicated server tool, 5206950.
# SRCDS_BETAID - beta branch of a steam app. Leave blank to install normal branch
# SRCDS_BETAPASS - password for a beta branch should one be required during private or closed testing phases.. Leave blank for no password.
# INSTALL_FLAGS - Any additional SteamCMD flags to pass during install.
#
 ##

# Install packages. Default packages below are not required if using our existing install image thus speeding up the install process.
#apt -y update
#apt -y --no-install-recommends install curl lib32gcc-s1 ca-certificates

## just in case someone removed the defaults.
if [[ "${STEAM_USER}" == "" ]] || [[ "${STEAM_PASS}" == "" ]]; then
    echo -e "steam user is not set.\n"
    echo -e "Using anonymous user.\n"
    STEAM_USER=anonymous
    STEAM_PASS=""
    STEAM_AUTH=""
else
    echo -e "user set to ${STEAM_USER}"
fi

## download and install steamcmd
cd /tmp
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzvf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamapps # Fix steamcmd disk write error when this folder is missing
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd

# SteamCMD fails otherwise for some reason, even running as root.
# This is changed at the end of the install process anyways.
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server

## install game using steamcmd
##
## The dedicated server is a Windows build. The app publishes a Linux depot, but
## it only holds the Steamworks runtime - the server binaries themselves are
## Windows only, so the Windows platform is forced here. The native Steam
## client library is staged further down, because the Windows one needs it.
./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login ${STEAM_USER} ${STEAM_PASS} ${STEAM_AUTH} +@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAID} ]] || printf %s "-beta ${SRCDS_BETAID}" ) $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAPASS} ]] || printf %s "-betapassword ${SRCDS_BETAPASS}" ) ${INSTALL_FLAGS} validate +quit ## other flags may be needed depending on install.

## stage the native Steam client library
##
## The server's Steam API loads steamclient64.dll, and that library talks to the
## native one in this folder. Without it the API init fails and the server
## shuts down again right after it loaded the map.
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

## stage the Windows Steam client libraries
##
## The Steam API also looks for steamclient64.dll next to the server executable,
## so the Windows redistributable has to be copied there as well.
for lib in steamclient64.dll steamclient.dll steamwebrtc64.dll steamwebrtc.dll; do
    if [ ! -f "/mnt/server/${lib}" ]; then
        echo >&2
        echo "error: ${lib} is missing from the installation." >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    cp -v "/mnt/server/${lib}" "/mnt/server/MZClient/Binaries/Win64/${lib}"
done

## The server writes its own configuration on the first run. Seed it here so
## the panel has something to edit, and so reopenConsoleOnClose is off from
## the start: the console helper it spawns gets EOF on stdin in a container and
## exits, and the server then respawns it in a loop until it gives up.
mkdir -p /mnt/server/MZClient/Saved/Config
if [ ! -f /mnt/server/MZClient/Saved/Config/serverconfig.json ]; then
cat << EOF > /mnt/server/MZClient/Saved/Config/serverconfig.json
{
    "port": 27015,
    "public": true,
    "name": "God Save Birmingham Server",
    "description": "",
    "publicAddress": "0.0.0.0",
    "password": "",
    "maxPlayers": 4,
    "reopenConsoleOnClose": false
}
EOF
fi

## create .pteroignore to only back up necessary files
if [ ! -f /mnt/server/.pteroignore ]; then
    echo "Creating default .pteroignore"
    cat << EOF > /mnt/server/.pteroignore
    *
    !MZClient/Saved/Config/serverconfig.json
    !MZClient/Saved/SaveGames/
EOF
fi

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"
